# Typikon

> Fleet web-property substrate: Zola theme, frontmatter schemas, scaffolds, bin tooling, and CI gates.

Typikon governs how consumer sites are built, validated, and deployed. Consumers pin it as a git submodule under `themes/typikon/` and keep site-specific content and brand config in their own repos.

Consumers may set `config.extra.feed_source_section` to make one section own the canonical root Atom feed. The contract is fail-closed and preserves Zola's native section and taxonomy feeds.

Product pages fail closed: a recorded price remains catalog data until sourced purchasable availability permits checkout. Shipping claims require paired provenance.

## Tools

`bin/typikon-init` - scaffold a consumer site or content primitive.

`bin/typikon-validate` - validate frontmatter against schemas.

`bin/typikon-check` - run the local web-property gate.

`ci/verify-release-lock.py` - replay the exact candidate, consumer PR/run/artifact, promotion, and rollback subjects before publication.

`ci/publish-locked-release.py` - reconcile or publish only the exact annotated tag, draft, and nine locked release assets while the verified evidence commit is current.

## Architecture

Structured LLM corpus:
- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): theme layers and tool surfaces
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): current substrate status
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted web-substrate decisions
- [_llm/glossary.toml](_llm/glossary.toml): typikon vocabulary
- [_llm/apis.toml](_llm/apis.toml): local CLI tools

## Agent Entry Points

- [README.md](README.md): overview, usage, and design
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): agent contract and locked decisions
- [schemas/](schemas/): frontmatter contracts
- Default page and section templates carry qualified `extra.greek` metadata on the single Typikon-owned H1.
- [scaffolds/](scaffolds/): reserved, currently empty — typikon-init scaffolds content inline
- [bin/](bin/): typikon-init, typikon-validate, typikon-check, typikon-refresh, typikon-migrate-template
- [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md): two-phase candidate, compatibility-lock, credential, rollback, and publication contract
- [release/compatibility-lock.schema.json](release/compatibility-lock.schema.json): closed v0.6 two-consumer evidence shape
